newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Q2 current deficit widens to $1.65 bln.
newsitem.headline: Israel Q2 current deficit widens to $1.65 bln.

text.p: The current account deficit in Israel's balance of payments in the second quarter widened to $1.65 billion, the Central Bureau of Statistics said.
In the first half the current account deficit was $3.129 billion against $2.407 billion in the first half of 1995.
Foreign investment in the first half of the year totalled $1.184 billion against $953 million in the same period last year.
Total Israeli investment abroad in the first half rose to $615 million from $295 million in the same period last year.
Net foreign debt was $20.493 billion, against $19.952 at the end of March and $20.191 billion at the end of December.

The statistics bureau also said Israeli exports to the Palestinian self-ruled areas totalled $675 million in the first half against $756 million in the same period a year earlier. Imports totalled $136 million against $204 million a year earlier.
